description: Verify that Multi-entry Subscribe (eg 0x02 + 0x05 + 0x06) — DUT acks/nacks each entry
approach:
[Objective]
Bundled SD entries: a single Subscribe SOME/IP message carries 3 entries — DUT processes each independently.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService with IPv4 endpoint.
2. Tester → DUT: SubscribeEventgroup with 3 entries (eg 0x02, 0x05, 0x06).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SD message containing 3 Acks/Nacks.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked all 3 subscribe entries — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer_with_endpoint: No OfferService with IPv4 endpoint within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_three_acks: No bundled subscribe Ack for eg 0x02 + 0x05 + 0x06
